prompt:
You are a 3-seat homestead council (steward / code / small) on CPU-only Ubuntu. Debate and produce a CONCRETE build plan for NOVA talking-avatar from PRE-GENERATED silent mp4s.

Pipeline to design:
1) Slice existing avatar mp4s into short segments / panels.
2) Identify each segment with a local VISION model (candidates on this node: moondream, qwen3-vl:2b) — label pose, face presence, mouth openness/shape class.
3) Recompile / organize into "mouth blanks" of different shapes and sizes (viseme-like classes: closed, slightly open, wide, round, smile-talk, etc.).
4) At speak time: LLM returns text → Pocket TTS (anna) reads it → choose mouth blanks in sync (viseme timeline) so the face looks like a human reading the reply.

Constraints: CPU-first; TUF GPU shared/busy; videos already exist on thumb (nova-ai/agents/avatar/*.mp4); do not invent new full-body animation; prefer ffmpeg + small vision + a Python stitcher.

Output STRICTLY:
A) Agree/Amend/Block per seat (3 lines)
B) Recommended vision model on THIS metal and why (VRAM/CPU)
C) Mouth-blank taxonomy (6–12 classes) with ffmpeg cut strategy
D) Sync algorithm TTS audio duration → blank sequence
E) Ordered STEP list (P0–P4) with PROOF each step
F) Risks (thermal, disk, lip-sync quality)
Keep under 900 words. Be specific, not vague.
